Definition: a Cushite, or descendant of Cush
BiblicalUsage: Cushi or Ethiopian = see Cushan "their blackness"; 1) one of the descendants of Cush the grandson of Noah through Ham and a member of that nation or people; 2) one of Joab's couriers; 3) (TWOT) Ethiopian
